sermon.title: Prophecies to be Fulfilled 01/13/2019
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In this short closing message Pastor David G. Kincer calls for the sacrifice of praise, then reads the prophecy of the mountain of the Lord’s house. He says the mountain and Zion are the church, that the law and word of the Lord go out from it, and that salvation is today.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Short excerpt; the recording begins mid-sentence. Captions read “as they are two three”; this is taken as Isaiah 2:3.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Now it shall come to pass in the latter days That the mountain of the LORD’s house Shall be established on the top of the mountains, And shall be exalted above the hills; And all nations shall flow to it. Many people shall come and say, “Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, To the house of the God of Jacob; He will teach us His ways, And we shall walk in His paths.” For out of Zion shall go forth the law, And the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.

Now it shall come to pass in the latter days That the mountain of the LORD’s house Shall be established on the top of the mountains, And shall be exalted above the hills; And peoples shall flow to it. Many nations shall come and say, “Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, To the house of the God of Jacob; He will teach us His ways, And we shall walk in His paths.” For out of Zion the law shall go forth, And the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.

faqs.question: Will God meet with me if I praise Him?
faqs.answer: He says if you do that, He’ll meet with you and reward you.

faqs.question: Why is it called a sacrifice?
faqs.answer: Because you don’t like to do it or want to do it.

faqs.question: Who flows into the Lord’s house?
faqs.answer: All nations; every kindred, tribe and tongue.

faqs.question: Will they learn war no more?
faqs.answer: He reads that they shall learn war no more and asks whether that has happened.

scriptures.text_nkjv: He shall judge between many peoples, And rebuke strong nations afar off; They shall beat their swords into plowshares, And their spears into pruning hooks; Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, Neither shall they learn war anymore.

faqs.question: What is God’s house?
faqs.answer: We are; His spiritual house made of living souls.

faqs.question: Who is the heavenly Jerusalem?
faqs.answer: We are, as in Hebrews chapter 12.

faqs.question: What will He teach us?
